Interface GSSRealm

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Contained, Realm
    All Known Implementing Classes:

    @Deprecated
public interface GSSRealm

    Deprecated.
    This will be removed in Tomcat 9 and integrated into Realm.
    A GSSRealm is a specialized realm for GSS-based principals.
